description: Performance baselines for datalake_fdw. Keys are <test_name>.<operation> pairs as emitted by perf_run_iterations into perf_results_summary. compare_baseline.sh reads this and flags any current p50_ms exceeding (baseline.p50_ms * (1 + tolerance_pct/100)).

baselines._comment: Empty baselines = first-run mode. compare_baseline.sh will write baseline_suggested.json into the report dir. Move suggested values here after manually reviewing them.
